title: What did you learn by trying?
subtitle: Look at the overall trend rather than any single day.
description: This week connected pain understanding with discomfort, pacing, sleep, and practical decisions. Now return to an earlier idea and one experience. You do not need to report an improvement to complete this reflection.

sections.title: Remember and explain
sections.description: Without looking back first, choose one: Why is pain not an exact damage measure? How is pacing different from avoiding activity? Then revisit the lesson if you need a reminder.

fields.label: How would you explain that idea in your own words?
fields.placeholder: A short explanation is enough. 'I am not sure yet' is useful too.

sections.title: Compare the prediction with the experience
sections.description: Recall Week 1's thought–action loop. Think about one activity or sleep-support experiment, or a clearly hypothetical example if you have not tried one. What did you expect and what actually happened?

fields.label: What did you expect, and what did you learn?
fields.placeholder: It may have been easier, harder, unchanged, or too early to tell. What does that suggest—and what does it not prove?

sections.title: Choose what to build on
sections.description: Keep moving within your plan. Keep tools that help, adjust what does not fit, and ask when you are uncertain. A repeated difficult response may need review rather than more effort.

fields.label: What will you repeat, adjust, or ask about next?
fields.placeholder: One specific next step or question. This reflection is not an urgent messaging service.

successMessage: Reflection complete. Keep your observations in mind for your next appointment.
